name: Brenen Prinzing
title: Sales Consultant
tagline: I’m passionate about helping people find their perfect vehicle. Reach me directly below — you’ll talk to me, not the main store line.

store.name: Cable Dahmer Cadillac
store.maps_query: Cable Dahmer Cadillac 1151 W 104th St Kansas City MO 64114

hours_note: Text or call ahead and I’ll have the vehicle pulled up and ready when you arrive. Ask for Brenen Prinzing, Sales Consultant, so you’re connected directly to me.
price_disclaimer: All vehicles purchase prices do not include tax, title, and registration fees. Prices include the listed rebates and incentives (All factory rebates assigned to dealer, including all applicable manufacturer rebates). Incentivized rates may affect incentives and/or pricing. Check with your dealer and or sales consultant to see available rebates you may qualify for. Offers may expire at end of month or the manufacturer date. We are not responsible for typographical, technical or misprint errors. EPA Estimates. Mileage May Vary. The Manufacturer's Suggested Retail Price excludes tax, title, registration, and optional equipment. Dealer sets final price.
